summary:
Verified iter315 header cluttering fix + Statement Decoder tweaks on web. All 5 requested checks pass: (1) header has exactly ONE nav-bell and 0 old lca1-alerts-bell-btn/lca1-alerts-bell-root; (2) dropdown shows BOTH the personal Notifications section AND a clearly labelled 'Aged care updates' section (notif-updates-header + notif-updates-section render), Manage preferences link routes to /settings/notifications; (3) combined badge (nav-bell-count) = 9 = personal(9) + aged-care(0) and decrements to 8 after marking one personal item read (no regression); (4) StatementDecoderTool intro

is now 2 lines at 1920px (height 58.5px / line-height 29.25px = 2 lines, class 'max-w-3xl' applied); (5) AcceptedFormatsPanel is collapsed by default in BOTH 'Paste text' mode AND 'Upload file or photo' mode with no file attached (accepted-pdf hidden), and only reveals after clicking accepted-formats-toggle. Header cluster spacing is clean: search | bell + account-health ring (gap-1.5, no divider between them per design) | vertical divider | participant switcher | vertical divider | account menu.
critical_code_review_comments: Nit: /app/frontend/src/components/LCA1AlertsBell.jsx is now dead code (no imports anywhere). Safe to delete to prevent accidental re-mount and reduce bundle size.

Nit: NotificationsBell.jsx polls /lca1/alerts/unread-count every 60s even when the user has no permission/aged-care feed items — a swallowed 404/403 is fine but consider gating by feature flag if the endpoint is not universally enabled.
Info: When the dropdown first opens, 'Aged care updates' briefly renders a 'Loading…' state (see screenshot). That is expected because loadUpdates() only fires on open; not a bug, just a UX note.
test_credentials: cathy@example.com / testpass123 (Family, used for authenticated header/bell checks). Statement Decoder verified anonymously.

rca of the issue: Not applicable — this was a feature/UX verification, not a bug hunt. Original user complaint (two bells, cluttered header, intro paragraph too tall, formats panel auto-expanded) is fully resolved by the diff described in the review request.
